Q: What is the max length name of a Azure Container Apps Managed Environment A:

Here are the naming restrictions for a Container Apps Environment:

  • Name length: 2 - 60

  • Valid text: alphanumerics and hyphens

The official docs often don’t mention these restrictions so we built an app to generate valid names for your resources, you can check it out here: https://www.clovernance.com

Q: What is the difference bertween these mapping libraries A:

To make sense of these options, try to separate them into two groups first, like renderers that draw the map (Leaflet, MapLibre, Mapbox GL JS) and data providers that supply the map imagery and terrain (Mapbox, MapTiler, OpenFreeMap, OpenMapTiles).

Leaflet is a great 2D renderer, but since you are building a tool to "show terrains with a route path", you need a 3D renderer like Mapbox GL JS (paid) or MapLibre (free and open-source). For the data itself, Mapbox and MapTiler both offer excellent 3D terrain and satellite imagery, with recency varying heavily by region for all providers.

Your best bet is to use MapLibre to render the map for free, and plug in 3D terrain data from a provider like MapTiler or Mapbox to draw your routes over it.

Q: Angular Universal - Title is not seen in View Source but can be seen during Inspect A:

If you can see the title of your Angular project during inspect, but not in the view source, it is likely that the title is being set dynamically through JavaScript or Angular code. The view source only displays the static HTML that is initially loaded by the browser, whereas the title that is visible during inspect is being set by JavaScript or Angular after the page has loaded.

This is a common practice in modern web development, where the title is set dynamically based on the content being displayed or other factors. Search engines and social media platforms can still access and read the title even if it is set dynamically, so there is no need to worry about it affecting your website's SEO or social media sharing.

If you want to ensure that the title is visible in the view source, you can set it in the static HTML file or use Angular's meta service to set it dynamically.
